title: Abandoned roads, crazy/broken bridges, touristy trails, and weird ways to travel?
content: A lot of my mallworld dreams have these types of things in them. Abandoned roads: basically its like the road is either dirt or really old asphalt. There isn't any new roads. Im usually using them to travel to specific places that im trying to get to, but sometimes i actually get lost and have no idea where i am. And usually there is literally nobody walking with me. Crazy/broken bridges: always across water or in crazy angles over hills/mountains. Usually dangerous or it feels super dangerous. High speed travel, im never driving but im always in a car with someone else driving. We make it over the bridges with exception to the destruction dreams. Touristy trails: huh... hard to describe but my mallworld is filled with them. They are kinda like these bike paths or walking paths that lead along hotels, waterways, the bridges, parks, water parks, restaurants, actual strip malls. You can usually travel a really long ways on them. I always want to skate/rollerblade or use scooters because they are really too long to walk on, even in dreams. But they always have these tourist like locations near them. Weird ways to travel: ties in with my last one. I have traveled in cars, boats, and have had to choose many weird ways to travel instead. Its like mallworld, cars are either nearly extinct or ONLY used on the crazy highways. Everywhere else inside towns or other streets, im forced to use even atvs or motorized scooters to have a vehicle. I can fly sometimes, but it seems like i cant use this for long travel, only very short distances.
